questionLoadXBRLQuestion.label: How do I upload a file to generate the XBRL?
questionLoadXBRLAnswer.label:
Use the button above the main table on the home page: you can click the button to select the file or drag and drop the file onto the button area, which starts the full XBRL Lite workflow.

Excel files must follow this naming convention: [Entity]_[Module]_[Domain]_[YYYYMM]_[Additional_information].xlsx
questionLoadImportLogsQuestion.label: How do I view the messages about the import process in XBRL Lite?
questionLoadImportLogsAnswer.label:
In the main table on the home page, click the button in the third-to-last column of the row for the module you want to view. This will display a table with a set of messages about that module’s import process.

To close that table, click the same button again.
questionLoadValidatedRulesQuestion.label: How do I view the validated rules in XBRL Lite?
questionLoadValidatedRulesAnswer.label:
In the main table on the home page, click the button in the second-to-last column of the row for the module you want to view. This will display the table of rules that were validated.

To close the rules table, click the same button again.
questionLoadGenerationLogsQuestion.label: How do I view the informational messages for the generation process in XBRL Lite?
questionLoadGenerationLogsAnswer.label:
In the main table on the home page, click the button in the last column of the row for the module you want to view. This will display a table with a set of messages about that module’s generation process.

To close the messages table, click the same button again.
questionLoadFilterModuleMainTableQuestio: How do I filter the modules shown on the home page by a specific module?
In the filter bar above the main table on the home page, there is a list of available modules called “Module”. 

Click it and select the desired module; the main table will then show only the runs executed with that module.
questionLoadFilterReferenceDateMainTable: How do I filter the modules shown on the home page by a specific reference date?

In the filter bar above the main table on the home page, there are two lists containing the available years and months, called “Year” and “Month”, respectively.

Click “Year” and select the desired year to show only the runs whose reference date matches that year.

Click “Month” and select the desired month to show only the runs whose reference date matches that month.

Selecting both Year and Month applies both criteria, showing only runs whose reference date matches the chosen year and month.
questionLoadCaptionIconsMainTableQuestio: What do the symbols in the first three columns mean (Import Status, Validation Status, and Generation Status)?
questionLoadChangeLanguageQuestion.label: How do I change XBRL Lite’s language?
questionLoadChangeLanguageAnswer.label:
In the top-right corner, there is a button showing the currently selected language.

To change the language, click that button and choose the desired option.
questionLoadPermitedFilesQuestion.label: Which documents should I use to generate the XBRL?
questionLoadPermitedFilesAnswer.label: Use documents that comply with the EBA taxonomy — i.e., files prepared using the corresponding templates and in accordance with the applicable Implementing Technical Standards (ITS).
questionLoadDownloadTemplatesPageQuestio: Where can I download empty templates to generate XBRL?
If you don’t have an empty template that complies with the Implementing Technical Standards (ITS), you can obtain one via XBRL Lite. In the top-right corner there is a “Usage Templates” button, located to the left of the “F.A.Q” button. Clicking it takes you to a page with a table listing the templates available for download.
questionLoadFilterModuleTemplateTableQue: How do I filter the templates on the “Usage Templates” page by a specific module?
questionLoadFilterModuleTemplateTableAns: In the filter bar above the templates table, there is a list called “All Modules”. Click it and select the desired module to show only the templates available for download that match that module. You can apply several filters at the same time — by module, reference date, and version.
questionLoadFilterBeginDateTemplateTable: How can I filter the templates on the “Usage Templates” page by a specific date?

In the filter bar above the templates table, there are two lists containing the available years and months, called “Year” and “Month”, respectively. Click “Year” and select the desired year to show only the templates available for download whose start date matches that year. Click “Month” and select the desired month to show only the templates available for download whose start date matches that month. You can apply several filters at the same time — by module, reference date, and version.
questionLoadFilterVersionTemplateTableQu: How do I filter the templates on the “Usage Templates” page by a specific version?
questionLoadFilterVersionTemplateTableAn: In the filter bar above the templates table, there is a list of versions called “Version”. Click it and select the desired version to show only the templates available for download that match that version. You can apply several filters at the same time — by module, reference date, and version.
questionLoadDownloadTemplateButtonQuesti: How do I download the desired template?
questionLoadDownloadTemplateButtonAnswer: On the “Usage Templates” page, click the button in the last column of the row for the template you want to download. The download will start automatically on the user’s computer.
questionLoadReturnMainPageQuestion.label: After opening the “Usage Templates” page, how can I return to the home page?
questionLoadReturnMainPageAnswer.label: To return to the home page, click the Neyond logo in the top-left corner.
